req.title: Echo request headers
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /headers with a JSON object whose 'headers' field mirrors the request headers received.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /headers must return a JSON object with a 'headers' field that mirrors the request headers. I designed tests covering: (1) positive EP — standard custom header is echoed exactly; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — empty/minimal header set still returns valid structure; (4) DT — multiple custom headers all echoed; (5) BVA — header with a single-character name and value at boundary. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with custom header X-Test-Header: hello-world
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: system shall respond with JSON whose 'headers' field mirrors request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'hello-world'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert isinstance(data['headers'], dict)
    assert data['headers']['X-Test-Header'] == 'hello-world'
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type

test_headers_echoes_custom_header_exactly()

tests.name: test_headers_multiple_custom_headers_all_echoed
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with three distinct custom headers
expected: All three custom headers present in data['headers'] with exact values
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: decision table — multiple headers must all be mirrored independently
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_multiple_custom_headers_all_echoed():
    client = app.test_client()
    custom = {
        'X-Alpha': 'value-alpha',
        'X-Beta': 'value-beta',
        'X-Gamma': 'value-gamma',
    }
    r = client.get('/headers', headers=custom)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    h = data['headers']
    assert h['X-Alpha'] == 'value-alpha'
    assert h['X-Beta'] == 'value-beta'
    assert h['X-Gamma'] == 'value-gamma'
    assert h['X-Alpha'] != h['X-Beta']
    assert h['X-Beta'] != h['X-Gamma']

test_headers_multiple_custom_headers_all_echoed()

tests.name: test_headers_response_does_not_contain_extra_top_level_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect top-level keys of JSON response
expected: Top-level JSON object contains ONLY the key 'headers'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: negative — /headers must not leak other request fields (args, url, origin)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_response_does_not_contain_extra_top_level_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    top_keys = set(data.keys())
    assert top_keys == {'headers'}
    assert 'args' not in top_keys
    assert 'url' not in top_keys
    assert 'origin' not in top_keys
    assert 'form' not in top_keys
    assert 'data' not in top_keys

test_headers_response_does_not_contain_extra_top_level_keys()

tests.name: test_headers_header_value_not_mutated_or_truncated
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with a header containing a long alphanumeric value
Parse JSON response and compare exact value
expected: Echoed header value matches the sent value character-for-character
Length of echoed value equals length of sent value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: EP — header value integrity; catches mutations that truncate or alter the mirrored value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_header_value_not_mutated_or_truncated():
    client = app.test_client()
    long_value = 'abcdefghij' * 10
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Long-Val': long_value})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    echoed = data['headers']['X-Long-Val']
    assert echoed == long_value
    assert len(echoed) == 100
    assert echoed != long_value[:-1]
    assert echoed != long_value[1:]

test_headers_header_value_not_mutated_or_truncated()
